map.股息率计算器。输入年股息与股价，按 股息率 = 年股息/股价 求股息回报率，用于: Dividend yield calculator. Enter the annual dividend and share price and compute the dividend return from dividend yield = annual dividend/share price, used to assess stock earnings and dividend attractiveness.
map.股息率 = 年股息 / 股价: Dividend yield = annual dividend / share price
map.每股分红相对于股价的比率。: Dividend per share relative to the share price.
map.看每股分红相对股价的年化回报。: Look at the annualized return of dividend per share relative to the share price.
map.横向比较不同价格个股的分红回报水平。: Compare dividend return levels across stocks at different prices.
map.：股息率 = 3/60 = 5%。即买入价对应年股息回报 5%。: : dividend yield = 3/60 = 5%. That is, the purchase price corresponds to a 5% annual dividend return.
map.每股年股息 2.5 元、股价 50 元: Annual dividend 2.5 per share, share price 50
map.：股息率=2.5/50=5.00%，相当于每投入 100 元每年获得 5 元现金: : dividend yield=2.5/50=5.00%, equivalent to CNY 5 cash dividend per year for every CNY 100 invested (before tax).
map.由现值、利率与年数求投资未来值: Future value of an investment from present value, rate and years
map.由多期收益率序列求几何平均收益率: Geometric mean return from a series of period returns
map.股息率高就值得买？: Is a high dividend yield worth buying?
map.高股息率可能伴随股价大跌或分红不可持续；需结合派息稳定性与基本面，别单看数字。: A high dividend yield may accompany a price crash or unsustainable dividends; check payout stability and fundamentals rather than the number alone.
map.股价暴跌时股息率会失真吗？: Does the dividend yield distort when the price craters?
map.会。分母是股价，股价大跌会把股息率机械抬高，形成所谓「高股息陷阱」。判断时还要看: Yes. The denominator is the share price, so a sharp price drop mechanically lifts the dividend yield, creating the so-called "high dividend trap". Judge also whether the total dividend is stable and whether cuts are likely; do not stare at the ratio alone.
